chain.text: UN weather body: this El Niño may be among the strongest since 1950
Weak rains: drought in 217 of 240 Karnataka taluks, 388 AP mandals
Retail inflation hit 5.54% in Sept, a 23-month high; onions doubled
RBI already raised its key rate to 5.50% to cool prices
Pricier canteen meals now; floating-rate loan EMIs can rise too

title: El Niño → your thali and EMI
why: A warm Pacific means weaker rain, smaller harvests and costlier food. RBI fights that with higher rates, which also make loans dearer.
